synopsis: Aphra Brandreth is the Conservative MP for Chester South and Eddisbury, and has been an MP continually since 4 July 2024. She currently undertakes the roles of Shadow Parliamentary Under Secretary (Environment, Food and Rural Affairs), and Opposition Whip (Commons).
